title: artocarpus zeylanicus
intro: Artocarpus zeylanicus, commonly known as Jackfruit, is a tropical tree species native to parts of Asia and Africa. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and regulate blood sugar levels due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Artocarpus zeylanicus include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
